reviews.text: Esta crema no puede faltar entre mis favoritos este se quedó como indispensable en mi rutina la utilizo casi todos los días con esa sello mi rutina de esquí de la noche también uso su línea de crema y de 0 esta línea es perfecta
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜絕對係我嘅必選之一，已經成為我護膚程序入面唔可以缺少嘅一樣。我差唔多每日都用，配合我嘅夜間護膚程序。我亦都用緊佢哋嘅面霜系列，而呢個系列好完美。

reviews.text:
This is a really great cream! The formula is extremely rich and nourishing, and it leaves my skin feeling incredibly smooth and soft. It feels like a high-quality product.
My only real downside is the packaging. For hygiene reasons, I personally prefer moisturizers that come in a tube rather than a jar. While I am thoroughly enjoying using this up and will easily finish the whole thing, I’m not entirely sure if I will repurchase it simply because of the jar packaging.
reviews.zh:
呢款面霜真係好好！配方非常豐潤滋養，令皮膚感覺好滑、好軟。感覺好似高質產品。
我唯一真正唔滿意嘅係包裝。出於衛生考慮，我個人比較鍾意軟管包裝嘅保濕霜，而唔係罐裝。雖然我好享受用緊呢款，而且一定會用晒，但我唔肯定會唔會再買，純粹因為罐裝包裝。

reviews.text: this is my absolute favourite face cream! I use it as part of my PM routine. leaves my skin feeling hydrated and firm. it is unscented and absorbs quickly with no greasy residue. I have sensitive skin and this doesn’t irritate me at all!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最愛嘅面霜！我夜間護膚流程會用。令皮膚感覺水潤、緊緻。冇香味，吸收得快，唔會有油膩殘留。我皮膚敏感，但呢款完全唔會刺激我！

reviews.text:
I’ve tried many face creams so far, but very few have impressed me this much from the very first use!
The cream instantly smooths and firms the skin. It has a rich texture, yet it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It’s amazing that the subtle tightening effect can be felt throughout the entire day.
Nothing but praise for this wonderful cream—it’s definitely going to be one of my favorites for 2026.
Love, love, love!
reviews.zh:
我試過好多款面霜，但好少會一用就令我咁驚喜！
呢款面霜即刻令皮膚變得平滑、緊緻。質地豐潤，但吸收得好快，唔會有任何油膩殘留。好神奇，成日都感覺到輕微嘅緊緻效果。
對呢款出色嘅面霜，我只有讚美——佢一定會係我 2026 年嘅最愛之一。
好愛、好愛、好愛！

reviews.text: I was really excited to try the SungboonEditor Silk Peptide Intensive Lifting Cream, and it felt luxurious from the first use. The texture is smooth and silky, absorbing easily without feeling heavy. My skin immediately felt hydrated and looked more lifted with a subtle firming effect over time. It layers well with other products and keeps my face comfortable throughout the day. A great choice for added bounce and nourishment!
reviews.zh: 我好期待試吓 SungboonEditor Silk Peptide Intensive Lifting Cream，第一次用就覺得好奢華。質地順滑、柔滑，吸收得快，唔會覺得厚重。我嘅皮膚即刻感覺水潤，隨住時間過去，睇落更有提拉感，亦有啲輕微緊緻效果。佢同其他產品疊用都好好，令我成日都覺得面部舒服。係增加彈性同滋養嘅好選擇！

reviews.text: i really loved this at first, but had been breaking out. Wasn't sure what was the culprit, as had tried several new products at the same time. it's been 2 days without this cream and the breakouts are finally going... sad to say, not for acne prone skin
reviews.zh: 一開始我真係好鍾意呢款，但係我開始爆痘。我唔肯定邊樣嘢係罪魁禍首，因為我同時試咗好幾款新產品。停用呢款面霜已經兩日，爆痘終於開始好轉……可惜講，呢款唔適合易生暗瘡嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: Une excellente crème qui tient ses promesses. J'ai une peau mixte, sensible, déshydratée, et mature (50 ans) et après l'avoir utilisée tous les soirs pendant un mois je constate que ma peau est plus rebondie et liftée. Je l'associe à leur sérum-crème collagène et à mon rétinol sans problème. La crème est assez légère mais bien hydratante, elle laisse un fini satiné ( cf 2ème photo) et elle n'est pas parfumée. Je vais continuer de découvrir leurs autres soins car c'est une marque qui mérite plus d'attention !
reviews.zh: 一款好出色、名副其實嘅面霜。我嘅皮膚係混合性、敏感、缺水，同埋成熟（50 歲）。我每晚用咗一個月，發覺皮膚飽滿咗，又提拉咗。我同佢哋嘅膠原蛋白精華霜，以及我嘅視黃醇一齊用，冇咩問題。面霜幾輕，但保濕效果好好，留低緞面般嘅光澤（見第二張相），亦冇香味。我會繼續試吓佢哋嘅其他護膚品，因為呢個品牌值得多啲關注！

reviews.text: Pelle secca, sensibile e matura. Sto usando questa crema da una settimana, in abbinamento al suo Creamy serum, scovata tra i Top Ranking in Skorea. La crema è favolosa e sarà super adatta anche per il periodo estivo. Molto idratante, rimpolpante senza effetto lucido, perfetta per amanti del finish naturale. Io amo il glow, ma questa crema ha un inci eccellente e lascia la mia pelle turgida e nutrita. Diminuisce l'effetto delle micro rughe. Ottima sotto il make up, non mi ha mai fatto pilling con spf. Super consigliata sia a pelli grasse che secche. Prodotto eccezionale. Tutto il brand è favoloso!
reviews.zh: 皮膚乾性、敏感同成熟。我用咗呢款面霜一個星期，配埋佢哋嘅 Creamy serum 一齊用，係我喺韓國 Top Ranking 排行榜度搵到嘅。呢款面霜好正，夏天用都好啱。非常保濕，令皮膚飽滿但唔會油光，好啱鍾意自然感嘅人。我鍾意水光感，但呢款面霜嘅成分（INCI）好出色，令我皮膚緊緻、有營養。減少咗細紋嘅效果。化妝底下用都好好，同 SPF 一齊用都冇搓泥。好推薦油性同乾性皮膚。產品好出色。成個品牌都好好！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
